newsitem.title: USA: Hallwood minority holder suit amended.
newsitem.headline: Hallwood minority holder suit amended.

text.p: Attorneys for Ravenswood Investment Co LP said Friday they had amended a lawsuit against Hallwood Energy Corp and now were seeking to recover damages on behalf of minority public stockholders of Hallwood.
The suit, filed as a class action, was launched November 15, 1996, in U.S. District Court for the District of Colorado.
A spokesman for the Ravenswood attorneys told Reuters that Ravenswood is the only plaintiff represented in this case so far.

They said the amended complaint alleges that Hallwood Energy, its majority stockholder Hallwood Group Inc and its directors violated federal securities laws and the statutory and common law of the State of Texas.
It alleges that the defendants engaged in a wrongful plan and scheme to cash out minority stockholders, the attorneys said.

On November 25, 1996, Hallwood Group said that over 87,500 share of Hallwood Energy had been tendered under its offer for the shares. Hallwood Group said it held over 92 percent of the outstanding Hallwood Energy shares.
The original complaint sought an injunction against the tender offer, which was denied, the spokesman for the attorneys said.
A spokeswoman for Hallwood Energy said the company did not agree with the complaint and would vigorously defend itself.
